title: Tuscan Pear

items: ½ oz orange juice, for floating

steps: Add lemon juice, simple syrup, limoncello, ginger liqueur and pear vodka to a shaker with ice. Shake and strain into an iced stemless flute.
Float orange juice on top without shaking it. Garnish with a lemon wheel.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
